0022600099.text: The Chicago Bulls (0-1, 5th in the Central, 15th in the East) visit the Milwaukee Bucks (0-1, 4th in the Central, 13th in the East), with both teams still searching for their first win of the season. Nic Claxton is out with a hamstring injury for Chicago, and Dailyn Swain, Jordan Hawkins, Josh Giddey, Tobe Awaka and Zach Collins are listed as day-to-day with illness, wrist, knee and quadriceps issues, respectively. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Bulls lost the season series 1-3, though Chicago won the most recent meeting 120-97 at home on March 1, 2026.
